title: KG extractor disagreement outcomes
description: The answers an untainted adjudicator may give when two KG extractors (GuidelineKG and the L1 KG path) assert different claims from the same passage of the same language version of a publication. Shown claims X and Y, never which tool made which. A ruling annotates the derived graph; neither source graph is changed.

source.note: docs/optimus-kg-integration.md section 7, Outcomes; the owner's decision that both graphs stay present and adjudication annotates rather than deletes (2026-11-17)

codes.label: X is supported
codes.definition: The passage supports claim X and not claim Y: X is annotated adjudicated, Y not-supported, with the ruling. An author can still select either.

codes.label: Y is supported
codes.definition: The passage supports claim Y and not claim X: Y is annotated adjudicated, X not-supported, with the ruling. An author can still select either.

codes.label: Neither is supported
codes.definition: The passage supports neither claim: both are annotated not-supported; a bean opens if it repeats for one tool.

codes.label: Both readings hold
codes.definition: The text supports two readings: both claims are kept, and the ambiguity is a finding for the L1 editor.

codes.label: Not decidable from the passage
codes.definition: The adjudicator cannot rule from the passage it was shown: the claim goes to the human reviewer lane.
